Seraphine|sup.identity: Utility mage. Stage Presence (passive): every third basic ability, she casts the chosen ability twice; casting abilities near allies gives her next attack more range and magic damage. High Note (Q) deals area damage, Surround Sound (W) gives nearby allies a shield and speed (and heals them if she already has a shield), Beat Drop (E) damages in a line and impairs movement, and Encore (R) charms enemies hit, with range that extends for every champion it passes through.
Seraphine|sup.playstyle: Poke and teamfight support: she harasses with Q, protects with W and decides fights with her ultimate. No clearly unfavorable matchups: her worst ones (Rell, Milio, Nami) stay close to even.
Seraphine|sup.early_game: Poke with High Note (Q) when your opponent comes to last hit. Count your abilities: the third one is doubled (double Q to poke, double E to root, double W to protect). Stay near your ADC: your empowered attacks have more range.
Seraphine|sup.level_1: High Note (Q) first. After that, max Q first.
Seraphine|sup.level_2: Beat Drop (E). Slows in a line; on a target that's already slowed or rooted, it roots.
Seraphine|sup.level_3: Surround Sound (W). A shield and speed for your duo, healing if you already have a shield.
Seraphine|sup.level_6: Encore: a line charm that goes farther for every champion it passes through (ally or enemy). Aim through your ADC or the enemy support to hit both opponents.
power_spikes: Level 6: an ultimate that charms both opponents.
First completed item: stronger poke and shields.
Seraphine|sup.lane_plan: Poke with Q, protect your ADC with W and keep E for kills or defense. Stay in the bot lane until level 5: since patch 26.16, your minion gold and XP are cut by a third elsewhere. The support role quest then makes your Control Wards cheaper (40 gold, two stored).
Seraphine|sup.trading: Basic trade: Q (doubled if possible), empowered attack. All-in: doubled E to root, Q, R. Defense: doubled W to protect, E on the diver. Against enchanters who heal more than you poke (Milio, Nami), play for CC.
threats: Rell, Milio and Nami: your worst matchups, close to even.
Hooks and engages that catch you: you have no mobility.
Assassins who target you in teamfights.
mistakes: Wasting the doubled ability on a wave.
Casting your ultimate without extending it through a champion.
Standing in front of your ADC against an engage support.

matchup_notes.Thresh: Stay behind minions; if his hook lands, doubled E on him.
matchup_notes.Lulu: Poke trades: your doubled Q wins.
matchup_notes.Nami: Dodge her bubble and keep W for her engage.
matchup_notes.Nautilus: His anchor pulls you to him: doubled E and R as soon as he arrives.
matchup_notes.Swain: He has to get close: poke him and root him.

Seraphine|sup.mid_game: Group with your team, poke with Q before objectives and place Control Wards.
Seraphine|sup.late_game: Stay behind your frontline. Encore through a champion to hit the group, E on charmed targets, doubled W to protect the whole team.
Seraphine|sup.ahead: Force grouped teamfights: your ultimate and doubled abilities win them.
Seraphine|sup.behind: Play utility: W and R stay decisive even without a lead.
Seraphine|sup.win_condition: To win this game, you want to harass in lane, then decide teamfights with an ultimate that charms several enemies.
Seraphine|sup.final_tip: Aim your ultimate through your own ADC: it extends and often hits both opponents behind them.
